svg.text: CPU per upload, one client: lower is better
The client process's user and system time per upload, in microseconds, at the same points as the nginx upload throughput. In
each panel the clients are sorted best first; under it, mimicry against the best of the other impersonating clients.
net/http, Go's standard client, as the reference
